lines.trans: I feel terribly awkward. I don't like being a burden.
And you are a burden. A burden!
Edik! — What, Edik?
Well, he's right. I was very rude to you yesterday.
I took your flowers. — You hear that? My flowers!
But I've understood a lot since that moment.
When you can't even wipe your own nose yourself.
Then you look at the world completely differently.
I could have died yesterday. Broken my neck.
I don't believe you! People like that live a hundred years.
Edik, why would you say that? — What do you mean, why would I say that?
Not why is he, but why am I? No, that's it, I can't do this.
I think I'll go. — Wait, Edik!
Eduard Valentinovich, please don't leave.
Your porridge. Enjoy your meal.
Try to manage without our help. — Thank you so much!
Are you mocking me? — Well?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Когда не можешь сам себе нос вытереть.
examples.trans: When you can't even wipe your own nose yourself.
Wipe your hands with a towel.

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

грубый.gloss: rough, rude; serious, gross (of a mistake)

examples.trans: There are many serious mistakes in the case.
I live in a communal flat.
It is terribly cold outside today.

meanings.note: что это значит? = what does this mean?
the form значит is used as a linking word

издеваться.gloss: to mock, to kid, to mess with

meanings.en: to mock, to tease; colloquially 'are you kidding me?'
meanings.note: Ты что, издеваешься? = Are you kidding me?

examples.text: Утром я обычно ем овсяную кашу.
examples.trans: In the morning I usually eat oatmeal porridge.
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: the end of a quarrel or war
the plural is used only in this sense
мы многое можем сделать = there is plenty we can do

examples.text: А мы многое что можем сделать.
examples.trans: Oh, there's plenty we can do.
Much has changed over this year.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Мне неудобно = I feel awkward / bad about it

examples.trans: It is very uncomfortable to sit here.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Когда не можешь сам себе нос вытереть.
examples.trans: When you can't even wipe your own nose yourself.

examples.text: От холода у него покраснел нос.
examples.trans: His nose turned red from the cold.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

обойтись.gloss: to manage without, do without; to turn out

meanings.en: to get by without, manage without
всё обошлось = everything turned out fine

examples.trans: Try to manage without our help.
We will easily manage without a car.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: И будут общаться со мной по-другому.

meanings.note: parenthetical word softening a decision or opinion, set off by commas

examples.text: Я, пожалуй, выпью ещё чашку чая.
examples.trans: I think I'll have another cup of tea.

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it

meanings.en: to try hard, do one's best

examples.trans: Try to manage without our help.
I will try to come on time.

meanings.note: short form: ты прав = you're right
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

свернуть.gloss: to turn; to roll up (свернуть горы = move mountains)

examples.text: Мы бы с тобой горы свернули!
examples.trans: You and I would have moved mountains!

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
сто пятьдесят = a hundred and fifty; сто рублей = a hundred roubles

examples.trans: I've got a hundred and ten.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)
быть в тягость (кому-то) = to be a burden (on someone)
meanings.note: third-declension feminine noun, mostly used in the phrase в тягость

examples.text: Я не люблю быть в тягость.
examples.trans: I don't like being a burden.

examples.text: Он не хотел быть никому в тягость.
examples.trans: He didn't want to be a burden to anyone.

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.note: plural цветы is used for cut flowers / a bouquet

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.

examples.text: Я мог вчера умереть. Свернуть шею.
examples.trans: I could have died yesterday. Broken my neck.

examples.text: На шее у неё был тёплый шарф.
examples.trans: She had a warm scarf around her neck.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
